data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Chemical agents, peels & baths_

**Class:** Phenolic keratolytic, antiseptic and peeling agent

## Mechanism of action
- Keratolytic (breaks keratin hydrogen bonds), antibacterial and antifungal

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Acne (2% with sulphur), seborrhoeic dermatitis, component of Jessner's solution and Castellani's paint, Unna's paste (resorcinol paste peel)

## Dose & formulations
- 1–2% creams/lotions; 14% in Jessner's

## Adverse effects
- Contact dermatitis, brown-black discolouration of light hair, exogenous ochronosis; myxoedema with chronic large-area use (antithyroid), methaemoglobinaemia in infants

## Contraindications
- Infants, large areas, broken skin

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid large areas.

## Viva points
- Antithyroid effect with chronic absorption; component of Jessner's solution

_Sources: Khopkar ch.30 (Resorcinol). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
